title: Water park anyone?
content: A long time ago I had this dream when I was (kind of) invited to this place. The dream begins with me in the back seat of a car going to this place I was invited. Then I suddenly was there: it was something between a waterpark and a not so fancy resort. I wandered there for a while and everyone was nice and gentle to me. People were mostly between 40 to 70yo and their swimsuits and hairs had basic colours like blue, red, yellow and green... I remember passing by showers, swimming pools, and some area with kiosks... There was also a small theater and it looked like something from the 70's... It was a strange dream because I had this feeling that it was important like some sort of revelation to me... I never forgot that dream and that place... Has anyone being in some place like this?
